svg.aria-label: The same Terse wallpaper field shown dead-on and orbited: flat head-on, and a real three-dimensional relief once the camera moves.
svg.title: Terse wallpaper — the same field, dead-on and orbited
svg.desc: Two frames from the live engine. Nothing changed between them but the camera: az 0.44 rad, el 0.17 rad. The relief was always there — head-on you were looking straight down it.

g.text: Head-on, it is a flat sheet of particles
az 0 · el 0 · dist 1.00 — every free wallpaper stops here
Drag, and the same sheet is a relief
az 0.44 · el 0.17 · dist 1.07 — nothing moved but the camera
